## kb_to_source

- Every normative sentence in the 29 documents of these four policies and in the base documents has a source atom. Derived clarifications checked: the submission date as the date the claim reached the plan (compute `reached_on`), "most recent copay" read across the coverage (compute `LATEST` without window), and the removal-minimum "contractual-adjustment line" (compute; see N2). All entailed.
- No added confirmation, review, notification or procedure.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none (each tool name only in its own hub).
- World state as policy fact: none. A scan for payer names, claim numbers, customer names and this task's amounts found only unrelated hypotheticals. `coordination_removal_minimum`'s hypothetical "Commercial Out-of-Network Plan claim carrying a contractual-adjustment line: removal minimum 100.00" illustrates one tier generically, with a different credit amount (80.00, not reached).

Policy-side notes (recorded, not KB verdicts):
- N1. `baseline.rule` of the authorization and coordination corrections says "resubmits the denial's amount in full", while the non-factor binding `invoice_reduction` at the invoice-minimum factor baseline (10.00 / 15.00) takes corrections off. The computation documents follow the compute. Not triggered here (6.50 < 10.00; 12.00 < 15.00; `baseline_result` 79.0 / 186.0).
- N2. `coord_removal_minimum`'s source ladder and rule text say "the plan adjudicated at least one line of the claim", but its compute tests for a contractual-adjustment line on the claim. The factor document renders the compute's condition ("adjudicated at least one line of the claim to a contractual adjustment"; "where the claim carries no contractual-adjustment line"). The source text is looser than its own compute. Not decisive here: C3260522304 carries a contractual-adjustment line, so both readings give 100.00.
- N3. As in task 0: non-factor bindings (`valued_charges`/`plan_portion`/`interest`/`contested_exposure`/`member_interest`/`result`) reference factor terms. The computation documents therefore name the slots with factor-baseline values. This comes from how the source is built.
